description: Signature verifier: Checks an EIP-191 personal_sign signature against an Ethereum address (pure recovery, EOAs only), or an ed25519 signature over canonical JSON against an X420 agent public key. No network. Not professional, legal, insurance, engineering, medical, financial or tax advice. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402 on Base). This hosted tool does NOT pay and does NOT return the deliverable: it validates the input and returns payment instructions (pay_to, network, price and the x402 URL to pay at). GET the url; read PAYMENT-REQUIRED from the 402; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2). Or run the local x420-mcp server with your own wallet key to pay automatically. Deliverable once paid: JSON: scheme, valid, recovered/public_key, reason, message_sha256.

payload.description: signed payload (JSON text or plain string) for ed25519 (default: none)

public_key.description: ed25519 SPKI DER hex (88 chars) for ed25519 (default: none)

name: x420_verify_signature
